mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEAMS (team_id, team_name, capacity, invite_code, team_goal, king_id) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{teamName}, #{capacity}, #{inviteCode}, #{teamGoal}, #{kingId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, team_id AS teamId, team_name AS teamName, capacity, invite_code AS inviteCode, team_goal AS teamGoal, king_id AS kingId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM TEAMS WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id AS id, t.team_id AS teamId, t.invite_code AS inviteCode, t.team_name AS name, t.capacity AS capacity, t.team_goal AS teamGoal, -- 💡 필요하다면 현재 팀에 몇 명이 참여 중인지 서브쿼리로 동적 연산 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TEAM_MEMBERS tm2 WHERE tm2.team_id = t.id) AS members FROM TEAMS t INNER JOIN TEAM_MEMBERS tm ON t.id = tm.team_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TEAM_MEMBERS WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND user_id = #{userId}
